definitions.gloss: work; piece (of art, writing, or craft); production
definitions.explanation: A finished creative work — a novel, film, painting, ceramic piece, or similar. Often used as a suffix (e.g., {新作|しんさく} 'new work') and as a counter-like noun in titles and reviews.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|さく}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{作|さく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧{作|さく}です。
examples.english: This work is his debut piece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{陶芸家|とうげいか}→陶芸家：20904_tougeika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|さく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Works by a famous ceramic artist were displayed at the exhibition.

notes:
Most often appears as a suffix attached to another noun: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧ 'new work', ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ 'masterpiece', {自信作|じしんさく} 'work one is confident in'. As a standalone word it is mainly literary or used in art/craft labels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧: new work; latest work
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: masterpiece; classic
- ⟦{大作|たいさく}→大作：12196_taisaku⟧: major work; epic
- ⟦{駄作|ださく}→駄作：16860_dasaku⟧: poor/worthless work
- ⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧{作|さく}: debut work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: work; production — the more common standalone word for a creative piece
- ⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧: written work — limited to writings; emphasizes authorship
